title: Inbound Banking Customer Service Advisors
description:
Job Advertisement: Inbound Banking Customer Service Advisors (Temporary Contract)

On behalf of our client, a well-respected building society, an exciting opportunity has arisen for Inbound Banking Customer Service Advisors in Swindon. This is a temporary role for a duration of 12 months, offering a competitive hourly rate of 14.56, with a dynamic shift pattern between 8 am and 8 pm, Monday to Sunday.

What's on Offer?

Pay Rate: 14.56 per hour
Contract Type: Temporary (12 months with a view to going permanent)

Shift Pattern: 5 days out of 7, with 6 weeks' notice of your shift schedule. Shifts include:
- Early: 8 am - 4 pm
- Mid: 9 am - 5 pm / 10 am - 6 pm
- Late: 11 am - 7 pm / 12 pm - 8 pm

Note: The week you work late shifts, you will have that weekend off! Some weeks may require six days of work leading into the following week.

Role Responsibilities:

As an Inbound Banking Customer Service Advisor, you will:

Engage with a variety of inbound calls, providing essential support to our client's members.
Receive comprehensive training before taking any calls, ensuring you are well-prepared.
Work collaboratively with a supportive team, even from home, to ensure a seamless customer experience.
Handle a high volume of calls (upwards of 40 members daily), guiding them through online banking and discussing a wide range of products and services.
Adapt your communication style to meet the diverse needs of each customer, ensuring they receive the best possible outcomes.

About You:

Our client is seeking enthusiastic individuals who are passionate about delivering exceptional customer service. If you have a background in customer service and possess strong communication skills, this role may be a perfect fit! The following attributes are essential:

A genuine passion for doing the right thing for customers.
Comfort using desktop or laptop computers, with access to a secure and reliable internet connection.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while maintaining excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
Confidence on the phone and the ability to build rapport with members.

Why Apply?

This opportunity not only offers a competitive hourly rate and a supportive work environment but also the chance to be part of an organisation that values its members and strives to reflect their diversity. Experience in financial services is not necessary, as comprehensive training will be provided.

If you are ready to embrace a new challenge and contribute positively to customer experiences, consider applying today!

Adecco is a disability-confident employer. It is important to us that we run an inclusive and accessible recruitment process to support candidates of all backgrounds and all abilities to apply. Adecco is committed to building a supportive environment for you to explore the next steps in your career. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Job Title: Customer Service Advisor

Location: Swindon, SN25

Pay Rate: £13.00

Shifts: Monday to Friday , 9am 5pm

Contract: Temp to Perm

Gap personnel are currently recruiting for the role of Customer Service Advisor, SN25. The global garden furniture manufacturer is just coming into peak, and us working in partnership are recruiting for additional 2 Customer Service Advisors. Ideal candidate must have good English written and spoken, and warehouse experience would be an advantage. Must be also PC literate as lots of packing / goods in activities are involved in working on PC.

For those who demonstrate good attendance, performance and great work approach, there will be on going position available after probation period.

Job Duties:

Delivering a Customer-First Experience
- Put the customer at the centre of every decision and interaction.
- Deliver a friendly, professional and empathetic service across all communication channels.
- Take ownership of customer enquiries from first contact through to resolution.
- Build trust and confidence by providing accurate information and regular updates.
- Create positive customer experiences that encourage loyalty and repeat business.

Customer Support
- Respond to customer enquiries via email, telephone and other communication channels.
- Resolve customer queries efficiently whilst maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Manage customer expectations through proactive communication.
- Escalate complex issues where appropriate whilst maintaining ownership until resolution.

Order & Delivery Support
- Assist customers with order enquiries, delivery updates and returns.
- Liaise with Warehouse, Purchasing and courier partners to resolve customer issues.
- Investigate lost, delayed or damaged deliveries.
- Process refunds, replacements and credits in line with company procedures.

Product & Quality Support
- Handle damaged, faulty and quality-related enquiries professionally.
- Gather accurate information to support supplier claims where applicable.
- Identify recurring product or service issues and escalate trends to the Customer Service Manager.
- Ensure customer resolutions are fair, consistent and aligned with company policies.

Continuous Improvement
- Identify recurring customer issues and suggest improvements to processes and procedures.
- Help reduce unnecessary customer contacts by highlighting opportunities to improve the customer journey.
- Contribute to FAQs, knowledge articles and standard responses.
- Work collaboratively with other departments to improve service across the business.

Skills & Experience

Essential
- Previous customer service experience.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and computer systems.
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn.

title: Internal Sales Administrator
description:
Are you the person who picks up the phone and gets the problem solved? If you're confident on the phone, sharp with the details and get real satisfaction from looking after customers, this Internal Sales Administrator role in Calne could be your next step with a business that is growing year after year and keeps its people for the long term.

Following continued year-on-year growth and an expanded customer base, our client is looking for a confident, organised Internal Sales Administrator to join their established sales team. You'll be a key point of contact for customers, handling enquiries, building quotations and taking ownership of orders from first call to final delivery. You'll work closely with colleagues across sales, production and procurement to make sure every customer gets the right product, on time, every time.

Based in a friendly office in Calne, Wiltshire, this full-time role offers a competitive salary with a salary review on successful completion of your probation period, plus bonus opportunities. Working hours are Monday to Thursday, 8.30am to 5.15pm, with an early 5.00pm finish on Fridays.

As an Internal Sales Administrator, your responsibilities will include:
- Handling incoming customer calls and entering quotations and orders onto the system accurately.
- Delivering consistently high levels of customer service, making sure the right information is communicated every time.
- Managing a shared sales inbox alongside the team and responding promptly to customer enquiries.
- Taking ownership of orders from entry on SAP through to delivery of goods.
- Guiding customers to the right product solution for their application.
- Preparing and sending your own quotations promptly and following up where needed.
- Issuing order confirmations and checking for customer acknowledgement.
- Liaising with Production once orders are placed to prevent and resolve any issues.
- Working closely with the Procurement Manager on order requests and outstanding orders, and keeping customers updated.

The role of Internal Sales Administrator requires the following skills and experience:
- Experience in a sales, customer service or office administration environment. We would also welcome applications from candidates with retail, hospitality or call centre experience looking to move into a corporate setting.
- Confident, articulate and enthusiastic communication skills, with a natural ease on the phone.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to multitask in a busy environment.
- A sharp eye for detail and a customer-first mindset.
- Good computer and keyboard skills.
- Minimum GCSE Grade C or 4/5 (or equivalent) in Maths and English.
- Sales training, telephone sales experience or familiarity with SAP Business One is desirable but not essential, as full training is provided.

About the Role

As Internal Sales Administrator, you'll join a supportive, close-knit sales team where around 90% of your work will be inbound calls and enquiries. Customers will come to you for order updates, quotations and advice on which product best suits their needs, so you'll quickly build valuable product knowledge. You'll receive full training on SAP, including how to process orders through the system, so you can hit the ground running with confidence.

You'll also be partnered with a member of the external sales team through a buddy system, working together to manage customer requirements and keep orders moving. With enquiries shared between teams across two UK sites, there's a real sense of team effort and collaboration. title: Document Controller
description:
St David Recruitment are seeking an experienced, highly organised and detail-oriented Document Controller to support a live civils site in Bridgwater. Ensuring all project documentation, drawings and technical information are accurately controlled, up to date and accessible to the site team.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage, register, file and distribute all project documentation.
- Maintain drawing registers, document registers and revision control.
- Ensure site teams and subcontractors have access to the latest approved drawings and information.
- Manage project documentation through the Common Data Environment (CDE).
- Track RFIs, technical queries, design changes and outstanding approvals.
- Maintain quality records, including ITPs, ITRs, inspection records and test certificates.
- Assist with compiling handover documentation, as-built drawings, O&M manuals and health and safety files.
- Liaise with project managers, engineers, subcontractors, consultants and clients.
- Monitor outstanding information and escalate delays or missing documentation.
- Ensure compliance with company procedures, project specifications and client requirements.
- Support audits and maintain accurate, traceable project records.

Essential Requirements
- Previous experience in document control or construction administration, preferably within civil engineering.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Experience with drawing registers, document management and revision control.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- Strong communication skills and a proactive approach.
- Understanding of the importance of accurate documentation on a live construction site.

Desirable Requirements
- Experience on civils, highways, utilities, earthworks or infrastructure projects.
- Familiarity with CDE platforms such as Asite, Viewpoint, Aconex or Autodesk Construction Cloud.
- Knowledge of construction drawings, technical submissions and quality assurance records.

Personal Attributes

You will be organised, reliable and proactive, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively with the site team. You will understand the importance of accurate document control, drawing revision management and maintaining up-to-date site records, ensuring the construction team has the correct information to carry out works safely, efficiently and in line with project requirements.

St David Recruitment Services is working as an employment business on behalf of a client.

title: GP Receptionist
description: The purpose of the Receptionist role is to provide a high-quality, professional reception and administrative service to patients, doctors, staff, colleagues, and other healthcare professionals, portraying the Practice in the highest possible professional manner. Receptionists are responsible for ensuring patients can access the healthcare services they need efficiently and courteously. They play a key role in supporting the day-to-day running of the practice and in ensuring the smooth flow of communication between patients and staff. Flexibility is essential for this role, and you will be required to provide additional cover during staff holidays or sickness. - Ensure an effective and efficient reception service is provided to patients and any other visitors to the practice. - Deal with all general enquiries, explain procedures and make new and follow-up appointments. - Use your own judgment and communication skills. - Explain practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover, and ensure procedures are completed. - Receive and make telephone calls as required. Divert calls and take messages, ensuring accuracy of detail and prompt appropriate delivery. - Enter requests for home visits into the clinical system, ensuring to carefully record all relevant details and referring to the rota doctor where necessary. - Enter patient information on to the computer as required. - Open and distribute incoming mail. - Photocopy and shred documentation. - Open up premises at the start of the day when first to arrive, de-activate alarm and make all necessary preparations to receive patients. - When last to leave at the end of the day, ensure that the building is totally secured, internal lights are off and the alarm activated. - Keep the reception area, noticeboards and leaflet dispensers tidy and free from obstructions and clutter. - Assist with the induction of new reception staff. - Support reception team members in managing busy periods and resolving patient queries effectively. - Process new patient registrations and action patient deductions. - Any other delegated duties considered appropriate to the post.
